sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MathVision: Qwen3.8-27B is evaluated using the fixed prompt: "Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed {}." For the remaining models, we report the higher score from two prompt variants—one with and one without the \boxed {} formatting requirement.

sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B Hardware Guide: From the RTX 3090 to the DGX Spark
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.8 27B Hardware Guide: From the RTX 3090 to the DGX Spark On August 14, 2026, Alibaba's Qwen team released the weights of Qwen3.8-27B under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face - making it the most exciting local model in the 27B class right now.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B at 34-38 tok/s on DGX Spark — open-source one-command setup ...
sources.snippet: All credit to the SGLang team (day-0 support + the lmsysorg/sglang:qwen38-27b image), RadixArk for the NVFP4 + DSpark checkpoints, DeepSeek for the DSpark method, and Qwen for the model. The SGLang cookbook's DGX Spark cell was marked "not yet validated" — consider this an independent field validation.

sources.title: README.md · gittensor-model-hub/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark-NVFP4 at main
sources.snippet: A full-NVFP4 variant including them was built and measured: it reaches 150.73 tok/s but acceptance falls to 2.546. Keeping QKV in BF16 costs ~3 tok/s and buys back the acceptance, which is the better production trade.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 27B on SGLang for DGX Spark - GitHub
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 27B on SGLang for DGX Spark by Mia's AI Lab Opinionated, ready-to-run scripts to serve Qwen3.8-27B with SGLang in Docker on an NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, aarch64). Three swap-in serving modes — EAGLE/MTP, DSpark, or DFlash2 — with every tuning choice measured on-device instead of guessed. DSpark and DFlash2 are faster on code.
